subject: Remediation status and evidence for RBAC & egress findings (Pen test)
messages:
From: SecureTests Engagement <reports@securetests.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, adam.reynolds@acrodata.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jan 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference — Pen test summary & verification request

Hi Karthik / Adam,

Attached is the high-level summary from our external penetration test conducted 2026-01-20 — 2026-01-25. Two findings we flagged as high priority for production are:

1) Overly permissive RBAC on the inference-admin service account — roles attached allow iam:PassRole and full EC2 instance profile actions.
2) Unrestricted egress from build/jump hosts (0.0.0.0/0) which allowed exfil attempts to a third-party sink during testing.

Please confirm whether fixes are planned and provide anticipated dates for evidence delivery (policy diffs, firewall rule exports, and any pull request/commit references). Auditor (AcroData) asked for evidence by 2026-02-05 to support the SOC2 report window.

Attachments: redwood-pt-summary-20260129.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)

Thanks,
Ben Ward
Senior Consultant — SecureTests

Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood Inference — Pen test summary & verification request

Thanks for the ping. Quick remediation plan:

- RBAC (inference-admin svc acct): remove iam:PassRole and replace broad EC2 roles with minimal set. Changes will be applied as IAM policy diffs via IaC (Terraform). PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/1214 (draft today). ETA for merge & deploy: 2026-02-03 (reason: change review + smoke tests). Evidence to provide: Terraform plan diff + resulting attached policy JSON and role binding audit log export.

- Egress from build/jump hosts: we found a legacy security-group rule allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on outbound for a short list of maintenance hosts. Marcus is applying a deny-any-egress baseline and an allowlist for approved sinks. ETA for deploy: 2026-01-31 (we can hit this earlier). Evidence to provide: firewall rule export (CSV/JSON) and cloud audit log showing rule change timestamps.

I'll prepare the remediation-tracker and upload evidence artifacts as they become available. Attaching current tracker draft for visibility.

Attachments: remediation-tracker-karthik-20260202.xlsx (draft)

– Monica Patel
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Date: Sat, 31 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood Inference — Pen test summary & verification request

Completed the egress lockdown this morning. Summary:

- Removed outbound 0.0.0.0/0 rule from sg-0234-build-helpers (changed to allowlist: 52.23.12.0/24, 18.196.5.0/24 for vendor transfers).
- Applied deny-any-egress baseline to jump-host ASG and added explicit allowlist for build artifact sinks.
- Change was deployed via pipeline (infra-deploy job #2489) at 2026-01-31T08:42:12Z.

Attached export of security group egress rules and the relevant CloudTrail event id for auditor trace.

Attachments: egress-firewall-export-20260131.json (export, 22KB)
